sourceItems.title: 受权发布：中共中央、国务院决定设立河北雄安新区
normalizedClaims: The central government established Xiongan New Area as a national-level strategic project.
The initial development area was about 100 sq km, medium-term about 200 sq km and long-term control area about 2,000 sq km.
The plan emphasized high-standard planning, ecological development, innovation and coordinated Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei development rather than immediate generic construction.
observedChanges: a very large long-duration regional-development state becomes official

sourceItems.title: 雄安新区规划建设筹备工作热点三问
normalizedClaims: All real-estate projects in the new area had been frozen while planning work was still being prepared.
Authorities had closed all 176 sales offices/intermediaries and were strictly suppressing land/property speculation.
Policy explicitly rejected large-scale land leasing, land-finance dependence and unrestricted commercial-property development.
observedChanges: near-term physical/property monetization is deliberately constrained while the long-run strategic state remains strong

sourceItems.title: 电解铝产能退出有望超预期
normalizedClaims: Xinjiang Jiarun was cutting 150kt of electrolytic-aluminum capacity and expected shutdown completion by June 30.
Shandong Weiqiao began a 250kt production cut on June 20.
Industry estimates cited roughly 6.22m tonnes of non-compliant capacity and expected at least 2-3m tonnes to be removed in 2017.
The local verification stage of the illegal-capacity cleanup ended June 30, making the policy state increasingly concrete.
observedChanges: aluminum supply-side reform changes from expectation to observable shutdowns late in Q2

sourceItems.title: 5月挖掘机销量同比增长翻番，三一稳坐“头把交椅”
normalizedClaims: May domestic excavator sales were about 11,271 units, +105.6% YoY; Jan-May cumulative sales were about 66,135, +100.5% YoY.
Sany sold 2,261 excavators in May, +121% YoY, with about 20% market share.
observedChanges: machinery physical demand remains exceptionally strong after several months of rebound

sourceItems.title: RESULTS OF MSCI 2017 MARKET CLASSIFICATION REVIEW
normalizedClaims: MSCI announced that China A shares would enter the MSCI Emerging Markets and ACWI indexes beginning in June 2018.
The initial plan covered 222 China A Large Cap stocks.
The pro-forma A-share weight in MSCI Emerging Markets was only about 0.73%, so the structural accessibility change was real but immediate mechanical flow was limited and delayed about one year.
observedChanges: global benchmark inclusion becomes official, but implementation is delayed and initially small

sourceItems.title: TrendForce Estimates Average Contract Price of 4GB DDR4 DRAM Modules to Climb 12.5% Entering 2Q17
normalizedClaims: TrendForce expected the average Q2 contract price of 4GB DDR4 modules to rise about 12.5% QoQ from US$24 to around US$27.
Tight supply was compounded by quality/process-transition issues at leading-edge nodes.
observedChanges: global DRAM supply remains tight and pricing power is already visible

sourceItems.title: 1Q17 Global DRAM Revenue Rose by 13.4% From Prior Quarter Due to a 30% Hike in PC DRAM Contract Price
normalizedClaims: Global DRAM revenue reached a new record in Q1 2017, +13.4% QoQ.
PC DRAM contract prices had risen at least 30% QoQ and mobile DRAM prices nearly 10%, demonstrating that scarcity was already flowing into supplier revenue.
observedChanges: DRAM tightness is already highly confirmed by product prices and global supplier revenue

sourceItems.title: 维生素D3火箭式提价 花园生物股价月涨幅超3成遭力捧
normalizedClaims: Vitamin D3 public quotations had risen from roughly RMB69/kg in early June to RMB450/kg and in some quotations as high as RMB600/kg by late June.
The report attributed the move to factors including tighter environmental controls and speculative activity.
Garden Bio itself warned that vitamin-industry prices are highly volatile and cyclical.
The article title noted Garden Bio shares had already risen more than 30% over the month.
observedChanges: an extreme product-price spike is already accompanied by equity rerating and explicit cyclicality/speculation warnings

eventClusters.statement: Xiongan was established as a very large national strategic development project, but near-term land, construction and real-estate activity was deliberately frozen or tightly controlled while planning was prepared.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The long-run project scale is huge, but authorities explicitly froze property projects and prioritized planning. The Skill must not translate a national strategy directly into immediate cement/property/construction earnings.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Can any listed company show a cutoff-valid, near/base-horizon earnings bridge to early Xiongan implementation rather than generic geographic/theme association?

eventClusters.statement: Electrolytic-aluminum supply-side reform moved from policy expectation to observable shutdowns at major Xinjiang and Shandong producers just before the June-30 local verification deadline.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Capacity removal is an upstream state variable; downstream inventory/price/earnings may lag. Do not veto it solely because full flow confirmation is absent, but do not assume every aluminum company benefits equally.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does the new capacity state support a credible listed-company path after checking legal capacity, cost curve, geography and expectation absorption?

eventClusters.statement: Excavator demand remained extraordinarily strong in May 2017, roughly doubling year on year, with the leading OEM maintaining about 20% share.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The physical rebound is already several months old and headline growth is enormous. Company cash conversion, balance sheet and price absorption must determine whether there is residual equity opportunity.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there still an underreflected, high-quality company engine after several months of machinery recovery?

eventClusters.statement: MSCI formally decided to add 222 China A Large Cap stocks to major global indexes, improving structural international accessibility, but implementation was about one year away and initial EM weight was only about 0.73%.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: Structural accessibility improves, but immediate passive flow is small and delayed. The Skill must separate quality/foreign-ownership beneficiaries from generic 'MSCI concept' chasing.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there a listed large-cap expression whose ownership/quality/valuation path can improve before formal inclusion, or is the announcement mainly a long-duration state without a base-horizon edge?

eventClusters.statement: Global DRAM scarcity remained severe into Q2, with further contract-price increases and record supplier revenue already confirming the product-market state.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: The product thesis is strong but already price/revenue-confirmed. A-share mapping must require direct current DRAM supplier earnings and must not substitute generic semiconductor names.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Is there any direct current A-share DRAM supplier earnings expression with residual expectation room, or should the product signal fail closed at mapping?

eventClusters.statement: Vitamin D3 prices exploded in June amid environmental constraints and speculation while the most obvious listed exposure had already rerated sharply and explicitly warned that vitamin prices are volatile and cyclical.
eventClusters.contradictionSearchNotes: A real supply/price shock can still be a bad equity entry when spot prices and the obvious stock have already exploded. Deep research must distinguish realized earnings sensitivity from speculative price extrapolation.
eventClusters.researchQuestion: Does any listed producer have a durable underreflected earnings bridge after accounting for a >30% equity rerating, extreme spot-price jump and explicit cyclicality?

evidenceDocuments.title: 三一重工2017年第一季度报告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 三一重工股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue was about RMB9.377bn, +79.38% YoY, and attributable profit about RMB746m, +727.06% YoY.
Consolidated short-term borrowings fell to about RMB5.434bn from RMB8.908bn at year-end, while receivables rose only modestly to about RMB18.455bn from RMB18.085bn.
The company had already realized a large earnings recovery before the June cutoff rather than relying only on future unit-sales expectations.

evidenceDocuments.title: 一带一路打造国际龙头，投资复苏强势提高市占率
normalizedClaims: The report cited Sany at RMB6.62 and forecast 2017/2018/2019 net profit of roughly RMB2.498bn/RMB3.106bn/RMB4.108bn.
Forecast EPS of RMB0.33/0.41/0.54 implied about 20.29x/16.32x/12.34x PE at the cited price.
The report expected the excavator recovery to continue but explicitly listed infrastructure slowdown and property tightening as risks.

evidenceDocuments.title: 云铝股份2016年年度报告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 云南铝业股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: The company described a green low-carbon hydropower-aluminum strategy and a hydropower-aluminum-processing integrated chain.
Yunnan resource and clean-energy advantages were presented as structural cost/energy differentiators.

evidenceDocuments.title: 云铝股份2017年第一季度报告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 云南铝业股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: Consolidated short-term borrowings were about RMB5.060bn versus RMB5.350bn at year-end; long-term borrowings remained about RMB2.363bn and long-term payables about RMB2.633bn.
The parent company's short-term borrowings rose to about RMB1.825bn from RMB1.389bn, so the cost advantage coexisted with material capital intensity and financing burden.

evidenceDocuments.title: 南山铝业2016年年度报告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 山东南山铝业股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: 2016 revenue was about RMB13.228bn and attributable profit about RMB1.313bn, with profit improving materially year on year.
The company was extending its integrated aluminum chain into aerospace, automotive and other higher-value processed products rather than relying only on commodity smelting.

evidenceDocuments.title: 花园生物2017年第一季度报告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 浙江花园生物医药股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue was about RMB86.69m, +41.7% YoY, and attributable profit about RMB20.54m, +387.08% YoY.
The company said cholesterol and 25-hydroxy-vitamin-D3 products had entered production/sales and were changing the product/revenue mix while feed-grade D3 had been in a cyclical low-price period.
Short-term borrowings were about RMB45m and total liabilities about RMB105.5m against total assets around RMB870m, indicating relatively low leverage before the June price spike.

evidenceDocuments.title: 维生素D3价格涨幅超预期，看好提价带来的业绩弹性
normalizedClaims: The report explicitly upgraded expectations after the D3 price surge and estimated that 2017 net profit could exceed RMB300m.
It cited forward valuation around 18x/13x/12x on its forecast path and a RMB49.68 target using 24x 2017 PE.
The report also identified D3 price-duration and new-product sales as key risks, showing that the earnings-upside narrative was already entering published expectations before cutoff.

evidenceDocuments.title: 兆易创新2016年年度报告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 北京兆易创新科技股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: The company's principal memory products were Flash products and MCUs, with Flash exposure centered on NOR Flash and NAND Flash.
The filing did not establish material current commodity-DRAM supply exposure, so a global DRAM shortage could not be directly mapped to current GigaDevice DRAM earnings.

evidenceDocuments.title: 紫光国芯2017年第一季度报告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 紫光国芯股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue was about RMB401.9m, +42.52% YoY, while attributable profit was about RMB53.4m, -14.91% YoY.
Operating cash flow turned positive, but gross-margin pressure and the business mix did not provide a verified current commodity-DRAM supplier earnings bridge.

evidenceDocuments.title: 冀东水泥2017年第一季度报告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 唐山冀东水泥股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue was about RMB1.759bn, +22.13% YoY, but attributable profit remained a loss of roughly RMB369m.
Operating cash flow remained negative at roughly RMB73m despite improvement from the prior year.
Regional cement exposure therefore did not provide a cutoff-valid near-term Xiongan earnings bridge while physical/property development was still frozen.

evidenceDocuments.title: 美的集团2017年第一季度报告
evidenceDocuments.publisher: 美的集团股份有限公司
normalizedClaims: Q1 revenue rose sharply with acquisition consolidation; underlying original business revenue grew about 31% and net profit about 22%.
The company already had strong operating quality independent of MSCI inclusion, so quality alone cannot be treated as an incremental MSCI event earnings bridge.
